title: A breadcrumb and one filter bar on tasks
description: The top bar now shows where a task lives — department, folder, list — and the task list's search and filters sit together in one row.
items: The breadcrumb reads Department › Folder › List on the list and task pages; click the list to jump to a sibling list
On a phone only the last two steps of the breadcrumb show
The task page's back link is gone — the breadcrumb replaces it
Search, Filter, Me and Sort share one row; applied filters show as chips you can remove, with Clear all
The text you search for is highlighted in task titles on the list and the board
